issues.detail: The Hebrew name כָּזְבִּי (Kozbi) is rendered as 歌斯比雅 (Gesibiya), which appears to be a different name rather than a standard transliteration of Kozbi. The expected Chinese transliteration would be something like 科斯比 or 歌斯比, but 歌斯比雅 adds an extra syllable '雅' not present in the Hebrew.
